content: {"episode_id":"ep-05031","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 (Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring) for this episode. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I49.5 and I48.0. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73), continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect arrhythmic events and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate-control management. Because the payer letter states this decision does not preclude a corrected claim or appeal, we request review and reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 718.50 on medical necessity grounds."}
